name: Daily sales report: SQL → Excel → email + Slack (weekdays 07:45)

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(total), 2), 0) AS avg_order FROM shop_orders WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND created_at < CURRENT_DATE

SELECT order_no, customer_name, customer_email, total, currency, status, created_at FROM shop_orders WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND created_at < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY created_at
